name: Tiger Brands Limited
summary: Tiger Brands Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of fast-moving consumer goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Milling and Baking; Culinary; Snacks, Treats, and Beverages; and Home and Personal Care segments. The company offers wheat milling and baking; and culinary, Davita, and baby nutrition products. It operates under the Albany, All Gold, Black Cat, Crosse & Blackwell, DOOM, Energade, Fatti's & Moni's, Ingrams, Jungle Oats, KOO, Maynards, Mrs H.S Balls, Oros, PURITY, Tastic, and Benny brands. The company also exports its products to approximately 22 countries. Tiger Brands Limited was founded in 1921 and is based in Midrand, South Africa.
